packages.title: Nebula

manifest.title: Nebula
manifest.appDescription: Nebula — add-on browser + player for webOS. Opens full on first run (starter add-ons preinstalled), leads with a featured hero board, and gives every title a full-bleed page with logo art, ratings, cast and description. My List library with an upcoming-episode calendar, resume and Continue Watching, next-episode autoplay, sync between devices with a short code, subtitle appearance controls, catalogue paging, and search across every catalogue. Plays and decrypts every format.

packages.shortDescription: Add-on browser + player: library, sync, calendar. Add add-ons by phone QR.
